title: In-memory limiter maps: one expiry rule and a size bound
evidence: (a) rate-limiter.ts isLive (now < expiresAt) is the one rule: createRateLimiter, createQuotaCounter, sweepExpired and the subscription summary cache all read it; the limiters had counted the expiry instant itself. (b) MAX_TRACKED_KEYS 50,000 per limiter map, SUMMARY_CACHE_MAX_KEYS 10,000; makeRoom drops expired entries first (writes delete then set, so insertion order is expiry order); a full limiter refuses the new key, the cache drops its oldest. (c) sweepExpired returns its timer; the gateway pin finds it by the cache map
durability_check: app/lib/ttl-bound.test.ts (US-52 AC4f, US-59 AC12: the key cap), app/lib/ttl-sweep.test.ts (US-52 AC4f: expiry instant; the gateway timer by map)
